title: The Obstacle Is the Way
author: Ryan Holiday
blurb: Ryan Holiday takes a line from the Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius and builds a practical philosophy around it. The obstacle in front of you is not just something to get past. It can become the path itself. Drawing on Stoic thinkers like Epictetus and Seneca, Holiday organizes the book around three disciplines. Perception means seeing problems clearly and calmly, without panic or self-pity. Action means attacking problems with persistence, creativity and steady effort. Will means building an inner resilience that accepts what cannot be changed and keeps going anyway. Along the way he tells stories of people who turned hardship into advantage, including Rockefeller staying cool in a financial panic, Grant at Vicksburg, and Edison after a devastating fire. The result is a short, energizing guide to handling adversity.

lessons.t: What Stands in the Way Becomes the Way
lessons.b: Obstacles are not detours from your path but raw material you can use to move forward.
